Algebra 2 · Unit 6: Rational and Radical Functions

Rational Expressions

Simplify, multiply, divide, add and subtract rational expressions.

What you’ll learn

  • Simplify rational expressions
  • Multiply and divide rational expressions
  • Add and subtract with unlike denominators

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 2: Graphing Rational Functions

Enduro Route Intelligence Lab

Model enduro stage times with rational functions: domain, asymptotes and holes, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing rational expressions, and solving for a target time. Then survey trail distances and wheel geometry with radical functions, transformations, rational exponents and extraneous solutions.

Level
Intermediate to Advanced
Time
25-30 min
  • 4 missions
  • Race clock and asymptote explorer
  • Split-time simulator and rational workbench
  • Trail survey and radical equation solver
  • Wheel explorer and radical profile studio
  • Final Route Analysis (12)
  • Optional route data diagnostic

Practices here: Add and subtract with unlike denominators; Simplify rational expressions; Multiply and divide rational expressions
